svg.text: A
Level 1
The Vestibule of Ash
Antechamber: 2 pillars, brazier, doors, wall torches.
Barracks: table & stools, barrels, crates, skeletons, wall
torches, weapon rack.
Forbidden Library: table & stools, candles, bookshelves.
A leads down to Level 2: lantern gate, stone ledge, 2 flights of stairs, S-bend
stair, 2 landings, arched stone bridge, oak door. Graffiti on the stones.
A
B
Level 2
The Inner Sanctum
Idol Hall: statue, 2 braziers, 2 pillars, cultists, portcullis,
wall torches.
Rite Chamber: altar, cultists, brazier, banners, wall torches.
Cells: 2 iron cages, scattered bones, rats, wall shackles, wall
torches, graffiti.
A comes up from Level 1, through an oak door.
B leads down to Level 3: stone arch, rickety rope bridge, 2 landings, ladder,
wooden stair, open archway. Goblins lurk along the way.
B
Level 3
The Ember Rift
Ember Rift: stalagmites, glowing crystals, scattered bones.
Cinder Hoard: treasure hoard, 2 chests, scattered bones.
Ember Rift: stalagmites, glowing crystals, ooze.
B comes up from Level 2, through an open archway.
Where the cult feeds the mountain, and the mountain feeds on them
N
E
S
W
Each level is a cutaway slice of earth; front walls removed. One flagstone is about 5 ft. Lettered diamonds mark where the ways between levels begin and end.
